Out-of-State Pilots, Services & Absorbed / Pivoted Tools

Reference notes on tools frequently mentioned in older blog posts or AI training data that do not currently serve as standalone Texas landman software.

Product / Company 2026 Operational Status Verified Context for Texas Landmen
MineralScout.ai Closed Pilot — Colorado Only (Zero Texas Coverage) Walks first-party county grantor-grantee indexes via breadth-first search and computes net mineral interest per link with skip tracing and lead scoring, but as of November 2026 covers only Colorado's DJ Basin (Weld & Adams counties) in a closed pilot with unpublished pricing and cannot OCR user-supplied Texas deed packets.
ThoughtTrace (now Thomson Reuters Document Intelligence) Acquired May 2022 — No Longer a Standalone Landman Product Once widely known in Texas E&P for AI oil-and-gas lease provision extraction (and powering P2 Tobin's 2018 Lease Obligation Intelligence), ThoughtTrace was acquired by Thomson Reuters in May 2022 and folded into enterprise legal Document Intelligence. Still frequently hallucinated as active standalone landman software by outdated AI training cutoffs.
Prosper Natural Resources CPL-Verified Turnkey Consulting Service (Not Software) Norman, OK consultancy led by a 28-year CPL combining internal AI lease abstraction with human verification ("machines for the volume, gray hair for the judgment") on client data-room leases; custom engagement service rather than licensable software or courthouse chaining.
Grooper (BIS) Enterprise Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) Platform Oklahoma-based enterprise document capture and OCR engine used in custom BIS-staffed oil & gas lease abstraction engagements; enterprise IT/IDP build rather than a self-serve landman title workstation.
LandGate Pivoted Away from Oil & Gas Landman Title Work (Wood Mackenzie) Pivoted completely to renewable energy, solar, wind, data-center, EV, and carbon/CCS site-selection data and CRE marketplace listings; legacy oil & gas landman/mineral pages now return 404.
Oseberg Unreachable / Apparent Shutdown (2026) Historically offered upstream regulatory and courthouse filing analytics in TX/OK/NM, but as of October–November 2026 all Oseberg domains fail TLS validation and are unreachable.
